name: glb-exploded-view
title: GLB Exploded View
description: Load a GLB or glTF model, take its named mesh nodes as parts, and explode, pile or reassemble them as a pure function of time. Supports meshopt-compressed models, a system filter (show one body system only), a heap-of-bones mode with a bone-by-bone assembly, a studio stage with floor and soft shadows, a cutaway plane and labels pinned to live world positions.
